messages:
maria: Hey team — HarborAI just dropped a 'solution snapshot' pack for the cloud marketplace listing + a short case blurb. They want marketplace publish by end of day Friday. Drive link: https://drive.company/harborai_snapshot_v2.zip

anika: Quick peek — thanks. PNG hero looks cropped awkwardly. Do we have an SVG lockup? Need flat logo (no shadow) and 1x/2x/3x exports for marketplace. Also suggest alt text below.

james: Branding note: partner logo on left, Redwood lock on right (equal visual weight). No overlapping color gradients. Clearspace: 24px around partner mark. Remove any drop shadow on partner lockup. :white_check_mark:

anika: Alt text suggestion for hero: "HarborAI + Redwood solution snapshot: low-latency LLM inference running across cloud and private deployments. Screenshot shows sample console with throughput metrics." 

leo: Legal check: short quote in blurb looks fine but we need written permission to publish the exact wording. Ask HarborAI to confirm the quote and sign a simple release (one-paragraph). Also confirm trademark styling for HarborAI (they might want ™). Remove any customer names from the blurb — we need anonymized language unless they provided explicit permission.

sam: For marketplace upload: required tile is 1:1, 1200x1200 px, PNG. Metadata JSON should include: title, short_description (<=150 chars), long_description, partner_website, support_contact, tags. If design is ready I can handle the upload/manifest. Also we need a 16x16 favicon for the listing.

janet (HarborAI): Thanks all — can confirm we grant permission for the quote below once final wording matches our legal. We'll send SVGs (flat + reversed) and approved copy by EOD tomorrow. HarborAI prefers the mark with ™ when used on marketing materials.

anika: Great. For hero crop — if they can't provide a wider artwork I can recompose but need the original high-res so we don't upscale. Also provide a 3:2 screenshot and a 1:1 tile crop.

james: Small styling snippet for marketplace tile (for devs):
```css
.tile-badge {
  background: #fff;
  padding: 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: none; /* remove partner drop shadows */
}
```

leo: Also flag: if HarborAI wants co-branded case study PDF on our site, legal will need partner-signed ROI/quote attestation and proof of customer permissions. That can be a follow-up.

maria: Timeline check — design + legal OK by Thu lunchtime, PM will upload Thu afternoon, ops publishes Fri 10:00 PT. Does that work? @janet please confirm the SVGs + signed quote by Thu 11a PT.

janet (HarborAI): Confirmed — we'll aim for Thu 9a PT with assets and signed permission. Sending now: harborai_snapshot_v2.zip (contains SVGs, 1x/2x PNGs, short quote.txt).

uploads-bot: Uploaded file harborai_snapshot_v2.zip (2.4 MB) to #partnerships — https://drive.company/harborai_snapshot_v2.zip

anika: Received zip — starting visual pass. Will post updated tile mock by Thu 10:30a PT.

sam: Thanks — I'll draft the metadata JSON template and paste it here when design mock is ready.

james: small nit — use our brand tone: change "low-latency" to "sub-100ms average latency" only if HarborAI agrees to that metric. Otherwise keep it qualitative.

maria: Noted. I'll coordinate final copy with HarborAI. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
